Chain-of-thought reasoning with search. Provides step-by-step analysis backed by web search results for analytical and complex reasoning tasks. Priced at $0.012 per request.
Exhaustive multi-step web research that generates comprehensive, well-cited reports. Ideal for deep-dive research tasks; responses may take several minutes to complete.

Graph-based website traversal starting from a root URL, returning page content discovered during the crawl. Accepts natural-language instructions and regex filters. Configurable via max_depth, max_breadth, and limit.

Neural semantic web search using natural language queries. Returns results ranked by semantic relevance. Supports inline content retrieval, domain/category filters, and structured output synthesis. Costs $0.08 per request.
Retrieve historical policy rate data from a specified central bank. Returns bank code, name, date, and rate. Requires uppercase bank code (e.g., FED, ECB, BOJ) with optional date filters.
List Polymarket events — the topic-level grouping that bundles related markets, such as an election or a season-long series.
Per-endpoint rate limit information. Returns RPM, TPM, and concurrency limits for the authenticated account tier.
Read wallet balance and API-key availability. Returns total account balance in USD (as integer microdollars), available funds, and API key-specific usage metrics.
Error codes and handling guidance. Documents all HTTP status codes, error types, machine-readable codes, and retry strategies.
Advanced search model supporting complex queries and multi-step follow-ups. Delivers AI-generated responses with citations and web sources. Priced at $0.012 per request.
Find tickers that match numeric conditions on financial metrics. Discover investment candidates by applying filters without needing a ticker upfront. Returns up to 100 results.
Retrieve Form 4 insider trading transactions for a stock ticker. Includes insider details, transaction date/type/shares/price, resulting position, and filing details.
Retrieve income statements (~32 fields per period) including revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, and EPS metrics. Requires period and ticker or CIK.
Pull named financial line items across one or more companies in a single call. Submit arrays of tickers and specific line items to compare, with optional period type and result limits.
Retrieve historical OHLCV bars for one stock across a date range. Requires ticker, interval (day/week/month/year), start date, and end date.
Search academic papers using Google Scholar or similar sources. Returns titles, links, snippets, authors, and citation counts. Supports result limits and publication year range filters.
Retrieve the complete text of numbered items from a single SEC filing. Requires ticker, filing type, and year. Optionally filter by quarter, item number, or accession number.
Retrieve current policy rates for ten major central banks (FED, ECB, BOJ, BOE, BOC, RBA, PBOC, SNB, RBI, BOK). Optionally filter by a specific bank code.
Accept an uploaded HTML file and convert it into parsed markdown format synchronously. Costs 1 Firecrawl credit per request. Uses multipart form data.
Retrieve a single X (Twitter) user's public profile by @handle. Returns display name, bio, follower/following counts, verification status, account creation date, location, and profile images.
Retrieve cash flow statements (~27 fields per period) including net cash flow from operations, capital expenditure, and free cash flow. Requires period and ticker or CIK.
Retrieve recent news headlines for a stock ticker. Returns up to 10 articles with title, source, publication date, and URL. Headlines only — article body is not included.
Query the EDINET filing list for a specified date. Returns metadata only (type=1) or metadata plus filing results (type=2). Required date parameter in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Retrieve reported earnings snapshots vs analyst expectations including revenue, EPS, and other financial metrics with beat/miss signals.
Retrieve the current price of one stock: price, day_change, day_change_percent, time, and market cap. The fastest, most cost-effective option for real-time price queries.
Retrieve all three financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) for a single company in one call. Requires period (annual, quarterly, or ttm) and ticker or CIK.
Lightweight search + answer endpoint. Cost-effective model for quick web searches with AI-generated answers containing inline citations. Priced at $0.012 per request.
Submit an asynchronous job to crawl an entire site rooted at a given URL. Returns a job ID; callers poll until completion. Costs 1 Firecrawl credit per page, configurable up to 1000 pages.
Retrieve a current snapshot of about 41 financial metric fields for one company, including valuation multiples, profitability, efficiency, and liquidity metrics. Requires only a ticker or CIK.
Submit an asynchronous batch scraping job for 1–1,000 unique HTTPS URLs. Returns a job ID to poll for results. Costs 1 Firecrawl credit per page scraped.
Retrieve balance sheet data (~36 fields per period) including total assets, current assets, cash equivalents, inventory, and equity lines. Requires period and ticker or CIK.
Retrieve about 49 computed financial ratios per period for one company over time, including valuation metrics (market cap, P/E), profitability margins, return metrics, and liquidity ratios.
Download a specific EDINET filing document by docID. Supports five file types: filing body/audit report ZIP, PDF, attachments ZIP, English document ZIP, or CSV-converted XBRL.
Discover and return all URLs reachable from a starting website. Returns a list of discovered links with titles. Costs 1 Firecrawl credit per discovered link/page.
AI-optimized web search that returns ranked results with page content already extracted. Supports search depth, topic and date range filters, optional LLM-generated answers, and image search.
Retrieve a list of SEC filings (not their contents) for a company. Query by ticker or CIK, filter by filing type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K), and set a result limit.
Discover a website's URL structure from a root URL without retrieving page content. Uses natural-language instructions and regex filters. Useful for scoping before a full crawl.
Retrieve company identity and classification information including name, ticker, CIK, sector, industry, exchange, location, and SIC classification. Accepts ticker or CIK.
Fetch one URL and return its cleaned main content as markdown synchronously. Costs 1 Firecrawl credit per page.
Forward analyst consensus for one stock: fiscal_period, period, revenue, and earnings_per_share. Requires a ticker; optionally filter by period type (annual or quarterly) and limit.
Search the web and return ranked results. Synchronous operation; accepts a query (up to 500 characters) and optional result limit (1–100). Costs ~2 Firecrawl credits per 10 results.
Extract clean, parsed content from one or more URLs you already have. Supports markdown or text output, optional images and favicons, chunk limits, and query-based relevance prioritization.
Extract full page text, summaries, and metadata for a set of known URLs. Supports text, highlights, summaries, and optional linked subpages. Costs $0.08 per request.
Edit existing images using AI models.
Submit an asynchronous research task to the Exa Agent. Accepts a natural-language query and processes it in the background, returning a structured result. Costs $0.10 per run.
Generate content using a Gemini-compatible AIsa model. Accepts conversation content, tools, safety settings, and generation configuration.
Generate images using various AI models including Seedream, Wan, and GPT-Image-2. Returns short-lived URLs to the generated images.

Generates chat responses supporting images, streaming, function calling, and logprobs. OpenAI-compatible interface. Also supports image generation via multimodal content arrays (e.g., seedream-4-5-251128 model).
Search YouTube and get back matching videos, channels, and playlists. Supports country code and language filters.
Send a structured conversation to a Claude model and receive a response. Anthropic-compatible interface supporting extended thinking, tool use, and prompt caching.
Get a direct cited answer from Exa. Retrieves relevant sources and generates a direct answer or detailed summary with source citations. Costs $0.08 per request.
Rerank a list of documents against a query using jina-reranker-v3. Returns results sorted by relevance score with an option to limit to the top N most relevant items.
Generate 1024-dimensional embedding vectors for one or more input strings using jina-embeddings-v3 or jina-embeddings-v5-text-small. OpenAI-compatible interface.
Generate 1024-dimensional embedding vectors for one or more input strings using jina-embeddings-v3 or jina-embeddings-v5-text-small. OpenAI-compatible interface.
Submit an asynchronous batch scraping job for 1–1,000 unique HTTPS URLs. Returns a job ID to poll for results. Costs 1 Firecrawl credit per page scraped.
